supplemental_actual_read_ranges.purpose: Coordinator supplement: actually read static initializer context for tool-list registration, no extra mechanism

comparators.distinction: Affix-based source reduction has no rejection/cue S2C. Here actual current-tool compatibility branch first caps/scales damage then conditionally emits an oriented live-target-attached receipt; config predicate and geometry availability decide emission. Scalar constants alone add0.

Wizardry explicit spell resist is an elemental rejection table and localized player message. Here it is a partial reduction branch without final immunity reason, broadcast to nearby clients and attached to target using computed hit-side offset.

Tetra first control cue ignores addEffect result; here no control effect request: tool eligibility/target marker causes scalar modification and geometric receipt before later damage adjustments. Shared warning that cue is not success is support0, not the proposed distinction by itself.

Dummy packet includes measured/recorded amount and source/crit and starts an independent billboard. Here payload has entity/dimension plus offset/normal but no damage amount/reason; particle follows live target with fixed world-space normal and ends on dead target.
ToroHealth observes client HP deltas, accumulates and shows independent moving text. This server branch can emit before actual HP change and translates with target during its own animation lifetime.

MineAndSlash explicit DODGE/RESIST enum goes to attacker and uses independent text strategy. Here partial compatibility reduction goes to radius32 clients, requires hit-offset availability, and transports an oriented target-attached marker without explicit outcome enum.

ColdSweat reads stored last attacker for knockback-only output. Here current true-source living hand/tool qualifies damage reduction and feedback before final damage; separate knockback helper is supporting context0.

limits: Coordinator actually read all45 listed ranges in five bounded, untruncated source outputs (0-5,6-16,17-30,31-36,37-44); also read OverworldItemHandler119-149 to verify static list initialization, rather than assuming an unshown registration entry. Hash checks are separate from this actual semantic reading. Ten extra old Herschel batch011 refs were initially located by name but that unrelated historical batch is not this proposal and confers0 new credit.

LivingHurt requires marker victim, living true source and nonnull active hand; chooses current hand stack, not projectile launch snapshot. Empty stack cap40 bypasses disabled-tool predicate via OR short circuit and emits no weakened-tool cue. Nonempty weakened tool caps then scales0.3; no positive-damage guard. Config whitelist precedes blacklist. Code has no target-dimension qualification, despite config description. Knockback branch is support0.

Server producer computes impact offset by AABB intercept of eye/look ray or immediate-source center fallback; null offset emits neither sound nor packet despite scalar reduction. Sound and S2C happen BEFORE gem/ring/thorns and final event.setAmount. Hence this confirms only a compatibility decision branch, never final HP loss, total immunity, final event acceptance or successful control rejection.

Payload contains entityID/dimension and six doubles, no amount/reason/outcome, UUID/epoch/sequence or finite-vector validation. Parent resolves matching current client dimension then actual live entity lookup; no absent-entity retry. Target-bound particle follows position while fixed world-axis offset/normal do not rotate with target yaw; dead target expires. Zero horizontal direction yields zero cross-product basis (static degeneracy risk, not observed rendering failure).

Factory merges supplied entity/offset/normal with fourth default maxAge=-1, applies RGBA and submits to effectRenderer. Split animation frame durations determine maxAge=totalDuration-1; single static frame duration0 can yield -1, and missing/small sprites take different paths. Native Particle tick/engine cleanup not expanded, so do not assert a constant successful visible lifetime. No PNG/audio was opened or asset changed; this is source decision/packet/lifecycle research, not a specialist asset acceptance.

Read exact accepted full_chain/concrete observations for all seven proposed comparator IDs. Apotheosis partial scalar reduction lacks this tool-eligibility geometric cue; Dummy/ToroHealth health-number birth snapshots differ from this attached target-position lifecycle; MineAndSlash explicit enum rejection has independent text/no such current-tool predicate; Wizardry spell resist is explicit policy text, Tetra cue ignores control admission, ColdSweat is last-attacker knockback weakening. Generic warning that cue is not success is reused context0. Previous Betweenlands shield batch only used this handler as gem context; new whole current-tool-reduction producer and oriented retained-target consumer counted1 maximum, all helpers/particle variants/other mobs0.

No native Forge1.12 dispatch ordering, getActiveHand behavior, actual damage, sound playback, packet timing or image quality test. Same-source config remapper external internals not expanded, no third-party global listener certification. All production gates remain below1000; no production, userworld, sharedJar or TODO modification.
